result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While there are some sidewalks and a grassy median, the environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design with long crossing distances and incomplete pedestrian paths.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this large intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The near right corner lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians onto the grass or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a protected refuge or signalized assistance.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the main road

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add countdown pedestrian signals to the existing traffic light infrastructure to provide dedicated crossing phases.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Transform the existing grassy median into a hardened pedestrian refuge island with curb ramps.

result.summary: The environment is highly car-oriented, characterized by wide multi-lane roadways and a complete absence of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no visible sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals, making the area extremely hostile for anyone attempting to navigate on foot.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossings forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and midground

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and a slip lane/ramp design encourage high vehicle speeds and increase crossing distances.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center roadway areas

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing Points
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross the multi-lane arterial.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the foreground

interventions.title: Sidewalk Network Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks along all roadway edges to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with pedestrian-actuated signals to provide safe crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Slip Lane Removal or Realignment
interventions.description: Close the high-speed slip lane or tighten the turn radius to slow down turning vehicles and reduce crossing distance.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and features a wide turning radius that may encourage higher vehicle speeds during turns.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the crossing, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide sufficient crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where signal poles are located.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively fast vehicle turns from the main road onto the side street, increasing risk for pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner on the right side of the image where the sidewalk meets the side street.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear guidance and timing for people crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corner to shorten the crossing distance and force vehicles to take turns at slower, safer speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features high-speed traffic with a posted 40 mph limit and long, unprotected pedestrian crossings. While high-visibility crosswalk markings and curb ramps are present, the lack of pedestrian signals and refuge islands creates a high-risk environment for people walking.

hazards.name: High Speed Traffic
hazards.description: A posted speed limit of 40 mph significantly increases the risk of severe injury or fatality for pedestrians in a collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible on the speed limit sign on the right side of the roadway.

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The wide continental crosswalk spanning the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners and signal poles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to clarify right-of-way and remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
